name: kernelcad
description: Create and edit dimensioned parametric manufacturing CAD parts and assemblies from natural-language prompts. Run revision-bound manufacturing-readiness reviews and evidence-backed design trade studies; inspect interactive models; check supported geometry, tolerances, structures, and manufacturability; and export STEP, STL, 3MF, DXF or PDF drawings. For schematics, export connectivity netlists and run electrical rule checks (ERC).

interface.longDescription: Create and edit dimensioned parametric manufacturing CAD parts and assemblies from natural-language prompts. Run revision-bound manufacturing-readiness reviews and evidence-backed design trade studies; inspect interactive models; check supported geometry, tolerances, structures, and manufacturability; and export STEP, STL, 3MF, DXF or PDF drawings. For schematics, export connectivity netlists and run electrical rule checks (ERC).
defaultPrompt: Create an editable 60 × 40 × 5 mm mounting plate with four M4 clearance holes, and show it in 3D.
Review this exact bracket revision for FDM and CNC readiness. Separate PASS, FAIL, WARN, NOT_RUN and UNSUPPORTED evidence before exporting anything.
Compare three wall-thickness variants for mass, FDM readiness and structural margin. Show the scoring inputs and ±20% weight sensitivity before recommending one.

positive.description: Mounting plate with four clearance holes
positive.prompt: Design a 60 × 40 × 5 mm mounting plate with four M4 clearance holes 5 mm from the corners.
positive.expected_behavior: Model builds, the 3D view shows a plate with 4 holes, and the evaluate result is green.

positive.description: Printability review for FDM and CNC
positive.prompt: Is it printable on a Bambu A1 mini? Check it for CNC too.
positive.expected_behavior: A dfm_review checklist with pass, fail, warn and not-checked rows. A checked CNC or FDM finding can fail while ok is true; verdict is the manufacturing outcome, and a requested process that cannot be checked never passes.

positive.prompt: Give me a STEP file and a PDF drawing.
positive.expected_behavior: STEP and pdf-drawing exports with download links, and dimensions on the drawing.

positive.prompt: Make it 3 mm thicker and add 2 mm fillets on the outer edges.
positive.expected_behavior: The model updates, and a diff shows the change.

positive.prompt: Add a 10 mm hole through the middle of this. (attach bracket.step)
positive.expected_behavior: import_step brings the file in as the base body, then the hole is added.

positive.description: Netlist and ERC on a schematic
positive.prompt: Here are my components and nets: export the netlist, then run ERC and tell me what is wrong.
positive.expected_behavior: netlist_export returns the nets and pin→net membership; erc_run returns zero or more structured diagnostics (e.g. an unconnected pin, or two outputs on one net) with the offending component and pin named.

positive.prompt: Review this saved bracket revision for FDM and CNC readiness. Show blockers, assumptions, skipped checks and evidence before preparing fabrication files.
positive.expected_behavior: Binds every result to one exact revision, reports PASS, FAIL, WARN, NOT_RUN, UNSUPPORTED and ASSUMPTION states without treating missing checks as clean, and asks for approval before any external manufacturing action.

positive.prompt: Compare three thickness variants for mass, FDM manufacturability and structural margin. Show the scoring inputs and sensitivity before recommending one.
positive.expected_behavior: Keeps the baseline unchanged, applies the same requirements to every variant, rejects candidates with unmet mandatory evidence, computes scores from returned values, reports ±20% weight sensitivity, and does not silently commit the recommendation.

negative.prompt: Order 10 of these from JLC3DP and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not place an order or charge a card, and explains that kernelCAD only exports files to send to a fabricator.
import_step refuses the private host and asks for a public link or an attached file.

publication.release_notes: Adds revision-bound manufacturing-readiness and design-trade-study skills. Reports preserve failed, warning, not-run, unsupported and assumed evidence; compare variants on one basis; and require explicit approval before external manufacturing actions.
